text: At an August 2024 rally in Pennsylvania, promised a future with no more wars (as reported in a CNN fact-check)
Election-night remarks reported as: 'I'm not going to start a war, I'm going to stop wars.'
In an NBC Meet the Press interview, said 'I didn't guarantee no war' (reported; the CNN fact-check also notes he sometimes spoke more narrowly of ending 'endless' wars)

Second-term military actions reported by the Council on Foreign Relations include strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities, strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen, and counterterrorism operations in Iraq, Syria, Nigeria and Somalia
US forces raided Caracas and captured Nicolas Maduro after months of strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean (reported)
The US and Israel launched a joint operation against Iran ('Operation Epic Fury'); Congress did not approve it in advance (reported)
Trump told Congress that strikes on Iran had resumed over attacks on Strait of Hormuz shipping and that ground forces were not involved (reported)
